_comment: FORMAT DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- this file is never scored.
lives under): the requests and citations below are invented placeholders. A query set
is a set of questions a person actually asked of these documents, with the citations an
honest answer must contain (docs/design/open-inputs.md section 3). Copy this file to
fixtures/evals/<your-set>.json, replace every placeholder, and point it at documents in
fixtures/real/. Each question appears exactly once in a set.
A citation is addressed in the set's own vocabulary: document is relative to the
fixtures directory; chunk is the 0-based ordinal in the accepted view's chunk list (the
same numbering the pair sidecar's changed entries use), omitted or null to expect the

examples.query: a question you actually asked, in the words you actually typed

expected_citations.note: why this chunk answers the question, so a reader can check the citation
chunk omitted: any chunk of this document satisfies the citation

examples.note: what a good answer looks like for this question

examples.query: a second question; each question appears exactly once in a set

expected_citations.note: the chunk that carries the answer, counted 0-based over the accepted view
